aiTexts: The Simplus 13-in-1 Airfryer features a 6.5L large capacity, suitable for families of 5-8 people.
It offers 360° hot air circulation and micro-steam technology for tender, oil-free cooking with up to 90% less fat.
Equipped with a sensitive LCD touch screen, it provides precise temperature control (80-200 ℃) and timer settings (1-60 mins).
Its upgraded ultra-thin design (80mm height) fits most kitchen cabinets, and the large visible window allows easy monitoring of food.
The basket has a non-stick coating for easy cleaning and includes an auto power-off function for safety and convenience.

product.desc:
*** Welcome to the Simplus Official Store.

Our focus is on vacuum cleaners, air fryers, dehumidifiers and other small electrical appliances.

Thank you, and enjoy your Simplus buying experience!

Product Features

-Compact body, takes up little space, easy to store

-6.5L upgraded large capacity, meets the needs of 5~8 people

-1500W high power, quick heating

-Visible cooking window, convenient for observing cooking status

-Holographic LCD touch screen, simple operation

-10 built-in preset menus, easy cooking

-Adjustable temperature 80-200℃, adjustable time 1-60 minutes

-360° three-dimensional even heating, no need to flip, micro-steam tender roasting

-PCB + NTC precise electronic temperature control, prevents burning (temperature rise curve)

-PCB + NTC automatic power-off, safe and worry-free

-Baking tray with imported Teflon non-stick coating, removable, easy to clean

-Pull-out power cut, with power-off memory

-Includes 10 sheets of oil-proof paper

⭐Product Specification

Brand: Simplus

Cord Length: 100cm

Power: 1500W

Adjustable Temperature：80-200°C

Adjustable Time：1-60mins

Capacity: 6.5L

Visible Window Size：200*110mm

safety mark: 240058-12

*** Simplus After-Sales Policy

- Customers have the option to return/refund the product if they are dissatisfied with it or if it has quality issues after 30 days of receiving it, along with images and reasoning.

- Returns are not accepted for used, damaged, or non-resalable items.

- If you encounter a warehouse error or send incomplete product parts, please notify the customer care via live chat, and we will resolve the issue for the customer as quickly as possible.

- If the buyer keeps the device for more than 30 days, Simplus provides a one-year warranty (exchange only, no repair). The customer must be a simplus member and can reach out to customer care via live chat for more details on the Simplus one-year guarantee and scope of use.

*** Note

- When unboxing the package, customers should photograph the goods to expedite after-sales handling if there is an issue with it.

- The one-year guarantee may only be used once per order.

- If an order is returned for reasons other than product quality, the client is liable for the return shipping expenses.
